import rates
from fixtures import load_fixtures, ROWS
from tabs import FixtureAccount


def test_accounts_are_separate():
    rows = list(load_fixtures())
    first = FixtureAccount("first")
    first.add(rows[0])
    second = FixtureAccount("second")
    assert second.charge() == 0


def test_each_account_own_charge():
    rows = list(load_fixtures())
    a = FixtureAccount("a")
    b = FixtureAccount("b")
    a.add(rows[0])
    b.add(rows[1])
    assert a.charge() == ROWS[0][1] * rates._RATES[ROWS[0][0]] and b.charge() == ROWS[1][1] * rates._RATES[ROWS[1][0]]


def test_charge_after_add():
    rows = list(load_fixtures())
    a = FixtureAccount("a")
    a.add(rows[0])
    first = a.charge()
    a.add(rows[1])
    assert a.charge() == first + ROWS[1][1] * rates._RATES[ROWS[1][0]]


def test_no_new_lookups_when_unchanged():
    rows = list(load_fixtures())
    account = FixtureAccount("solo")
    account.add(rows[0])
    account.charge()
    before = rates.LOOKUPS
    account.charge()
    account.charge()
    assert rates.LOOKUPS == before
